slides.title: ECDAT
slides.subtitle:
Enterprise Cryptographic Discovery & Analysis Tool
Problem Statement 26164 · NTRO · Blockchain & Cybersecurity
Team ID: SIH26164

slides.title: Idea: Discover → Quantify → Migrate
bullets: Unified crypto discovery across source, dependencies, certs & config
CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM export (validated)
Quantum-risk scoring with Mosca’s X + Y > Z framework
HNDL (Harvest Now, Decrypt Later) & TNFL (Trust Now, Forge Later) flags
Deterministic NIST FIPS 203/204/205 PQC & hybrid recommendations
100% air-gapped — source never leaves the environment

slides.title: Technical Approach
bullets: Input: local repo / dependencies / X.509 certs / configs
Discovery: Python-AST & Java API rules + evidence (file, line, rule, confidence)
Normalise → unified CryptoAsset model
Classify: SHOR_BROKEN / GROVER_WEAKENED / QUANTUM_SAFE / CLASSICALLY_BROKEN
Mosca margin = Z − (X+Y), scenario years 2030/2035/2040
0–100 risk priority → PQC migration → CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM → Streamlit dashboard

slides.title: Feasibility & Viability — Measured
bullets: Working prototype: controlled corpus scan, 41 assets, 10/10 planted classes detected
Real target: CPython 3.11 stdlib → 695 assets, CBOM validated
CycloneDX 1.6 CBOM passes official schema validation
Open-source stack: Python, Streamlit, Plotly, cryptography, jsonschema
Air-gapped deployable; no external source upload
MVP vs roadmap boundary enforced (JS/TLS/binary = OPTIONAL; cloud/HSM = ROADMAP)

slides.title: Impact & Benefits
bullets: Complete cryptographic inventory (algorithms, keys, certs, libraries)
Quantum-risk prioritisation via Mosca & transparent 0–100 score
HNDL/TNFL protection for long-lived data, signatures & root trust
Deterministic PQC/hybrid migration planning (ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65, SLH-DSA)
CBOM value for procurement and audit (CycloneDX 1.6)
Directly applicable to government & critical-infrastructure organisations
